title: enabled until request
rule: Keep Submit enabled until the request starts; then show a spinner on the request.
pass_when: Submit stays enabled until the request starts; then a spinner (in-flight) shows.
fail_when: Submit is disabled before the request starts, or in-flight has no spinner.
overview: Keep Submit enabled until the request starts; then show an in-flight spinner.
apply_when: Submit actions that fire a network or async request.
not_when: Client-only saves with no request that needs in-flight feedback.
agent_hint: Leave Submit enabled until request start; show a spinner while in flight.
description: Keep Submit enabled until the request starts; then show a spinner on the request. Pass when Submit stays enabled until the request starts and an in-flight spinner shows; fail when Submit is disabled before the request starts, or in-flight has no spinner. Premature disable blocks last-second correction; a missing spinner hides that work is in flight.
